name: Keycloak
tagline: Idempotently provisions Keycloak realms, clients, roles, users and groups from a YAML file. Built to run as a Docker Compose init container.

features.title: Realm resources
features.body: Realms, clients, protocol mappers, realm and client roles, users and nested groups.

features.title: Master realm hardening
features.body: Configure SSL and users on the master realm without full provisioning.

features.title: Strategy
features.body: update or create — globally or per realm.

features.title: Dry run
features.body: --dry-run logs every intended change without applying it.

features.title: Resilient and observable
features.body: Exponential backoff while Keycloak starts; structured JSON logs.
